_comment: Pricing calibration. The engine multiplies each component by the factor that applies to it, so a generated quote can be brought into line with the agency's published package prices without touching the rate card itself. Produced by `npm run calibrate -- --write`, and safe to hand-edit afterwards — your edits survive the next run unless you pass --write again.
_howToUse: Run `npm run calibrate` to see how every published package prices today. Where the generated price is wrong, either correct the underlying rate in Pricing_Rules.xlsx (best), or set a factor here (fastest). A factor of 1.0 is neutral; 1.15 makes that component 15% dearer.
_precedence: package > country > region > global. The first match wins, they do not compound.

region._india: Pricing_Rules.xlsx gives all ~200 Indian places the same template figures (airport transfer 6,496 and sightseeing car 5,315 per service), roughly 3-4x a chauffeured sedan in India. Scaled to about 1,600 per airport transfer and 2,900 per sightseeing day. Replace with contracted rates in the workbook and remove this entry.
region._indiaHotel: The same workbook template (USD 112.5 / 168.75 / 275 / 425 per room-night for 3 / 4 / 5 / Luxury 5 Star, about INR 10,630 / 15,945 / 25,985 / 40,158) is repeated for 203 of the 207 Indian places, and the gap-fill copies it to the rest. That is roughly 2.5x what Indian hotels charge in these categories (3 Star about 4,000 to 5,000, 4 Star about 6,000 to 8,000, 5 Star about 10,000 to 13,000). 0.4 brings it to that range. Replace with contracted per-city rates in the workbook and remove the hotel entry.

country._vietnam: Agency check of a 3-adult, 10-night, 4-destination Vietnam trip (Ha Noi, Danang, Hochiminh, Phu Quoc, April 2027): decent 4 Star rooms in those cities cost about INR 7,500 per room-night, not the workbook template's INR 11,990-12,700 (a hotel total of 2.8 lakh against a real 1.5 lakh at most), the Vietnam e-visa service is INR 3,360 per person against the template's INR 2,800, and the agency's retrieved fares for that routing (CCU-HAN, HAN-DAD, DAD-PQC, PQC-SGN, SGN-BKK-CCU) came to about INR 59,000 per person against the template's roughly INR 37,000 once its three domestic legs are counted. 0.5 and 1.2 bring hotel and visa to those figures; 1.9 on the international fare brings the air total to within about 8% of the retrieved one. The airfare factor is fitted to ONE retrieved itinerary and is a stopgap until live fares are switched on. Replace with contracted per-city rates in the workbook and remove this entry.
